first_page: Feed page /feed/ for readers who follow people across networks. First: follow Bluesky and Mastodon handles and subreddits (public feeds, keyless), merged into one time-ordered feed with sort, a threaded view for one post, saved posts and follows kept on the device, and a link that holds the whole follow list. Will not build: posting, voting, chat, moderation or an account.
